programs.title: Return to Paradise 2
programs.desc: Detective Mackenzie "Mack" Clarke (Anna Samson), instead of returning to her quiet life in Britain, remains in Dolphin Cove, where she tries to avoid her ex-fiance, who is planning another wedding.She focuses on what she does best - solving complex crime puzzles.Together with his trusted team, Mack engages in subsequent investigations, reaching, among others, the world of literature, modern research laboratories and rock concerts.He handles each case with his characteristic enthusiasm and sense of humor.However, the most difficult task for her turns out to be finding her own place in Dolphin Cove.
